description: Ul, a living old log beehive, a thick hollow log of dark oak with a carved wooden hatch and a small door hole, walking on short root legs, a grumpy face carved in the wood, golden honey dripping from cracks, an angry swarm of bees pouring out of the hole, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the hive alone, no tree, no ground, no background, the whole hive inside the picture, its bees too
